name: pinterest-social-mcp
description: Pinterest (social): me, publish_image, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

platform_mcp_pinterest_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_pinterest_client_id.description: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

platform_mcp_pinterest_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_pinterest_client_secret.description: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

platform_mcp_pinterest_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_pinterest_refresh_token.description: Refresh token (pinr…) from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, boards:read, pins:read and pins:write. Continuous refresh tokens last 60 days and every refresh returns a new one: the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/pinterest.json (mode 0600).

platform_mcp_pinterest_board_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_BOARD_ID
platform_mcp_pinterest_board_id.description: Board id new Pins are created on (GET /v5/boards).

tools.name: me
tools.description: Get user account: username, account_type, business_name, profile_image.

tools.name: publish_image
tools.description: Creates a Pin on config board_id from the first image URL (media_source {source_type: image_url, url}); `text` becomes the description.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Deletes a Pin owned by the user (204).

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: Get Pin with pin_metrics=true: 'Specify whether to return 90d and lifetime Pin metrics' — metrics carries 90d and lifetime_metrics (pin_click, impression, clickthrough, …).
